newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Satellite Q3 loss expands as revenues climb.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Satellite Q3 loss expands as revenues climb.

text.p: U.S. Satellite Broadcasting Co said Wednesday its net loss in the third quarter ended March 31 widened in spite of a surge in renevues.
The satellite programming supplier posted a loss of $22.5 million, or $0.25 a share, versus a loss of $21.5 million, or $0.24, in the third quarter of 1996.

Revenues in the period rose to $99.2 million from $57.0 million in the same quarter last year, with the number of paying subscribers rising to 1.4 million from 791,000 a year ago, U.S. Satellite said.

The company said average monthly revenue per paying subscriber, excluding pay-per-view and commercial revenues, was $24.86. U.S. Satellite expects that figure to remain between $24 and $25 for the rest of fiscal 1997.
The company's shares closed off 1/4 Wednesday at 10-1/8.
